answer.reason: Bethel is the scene of several events: Jacob naming it, Jeroboam's golden calf, and Josiah breaking down its altar.

clauses.english: was named by Jacob, who set up a stone for a pillar there
clauses.quote: he called the name of that place Bethel

clauses.english: was where Jeroboam set up a golden calf and offered on his altar
clauses.quote: And he set the one in Bethel, and the other put he in Dan.

clauses.english: had its altar and high place broken down and burned by Josiah
clauses.quote: that altar and the high place he brake down

doubts: 1KI 16:34 names Hiel the Bethelite, which only gives a man's origin, so it was left out.
The many verses that only give its position or list it (boundaries, towns, returning exiles) were left out.
Several verses (GEN 35:6-15, JDG 1:22-25, 2KI 2:23-24) tell of events there but were left out to keep the line short.
